description: C65 — 柏林残局：协调决定马对象优劣

intro.popup_en:
Piece Coordination, Practice 8
The Berlin Endgame is a queenless position. With material equal, coordination determines which side has the advantage.
intro.popup:
子力协调第8局
柏林残局是无后对局
双方子力相同，协调决定胜负！

outro.popup_en: Summary: Nc3, Bb2, and the rooks coordinate against Black's passive setup. When material is equal, the quality of coordination can decide the game.
outro.popup:
总结：Nc3+Bb2+双车协调vs黑方被动
子力数量相等时，协调质量决定胜负

moves.popup: e4开局
moves.popup_en: e4 opens the game and occupies the center.

moves.popup: e5对称
moves.popup_en: ...e5 mirrors White's central advance.

moves.popup:
Nf3出马
控制e5
moves.popup_en: Nf3 develops and controls e5.

moves.popup: Nc6保护e5
moves.popup_en: ...Nc6 develops and defends e5.

moves.popup:
Bb5西班牙！
激活：象牵制Nc6
计划：西班牙开局，准备进入残局
moves.popup_en: Bb5 begins the Ruy Lopez, pinning Nc6 and setting up a possible Berlin Endgame.

moves.popup:
Nf6！柏林防御！
这一步直接反打e4，不管Nc6被牵制
moves.popup_en: ...Nf6! The Berlin Defense. Black counterattacks e4 directly, accepting the pin on Nc6.

moves.popup:
O-O白方易位
激活：Rf1进入游戏
计划：准备d4打开中心
moves.popup_en: O-O secures White's king, activates the rook on f1, and prepares d4 to open the center.

moves.popup:
Nxe4！黑方吃兵！
柏林防御的核心：无惧失子，抓e4兵
moves.popup_en: ...Nxe4! Black captures the pawn. A key Berlin idea is to accept the temporary loss of the knight's support in order to take e4.

moves.popup:
d4打开中心！
激活：打开中心，威胁黑马
计划：白方打算通过d4+dxe5后进入柏林残局
moves.popup_en: d4 opens the center and challenges the knight. White aims for d4 and dxe5 to reach the Berlin Endgame.

moves.popup:
Nd6黑马撤退归位
黑马从e4退到d6，守备
moves.popup_en: ...Nd6 retreats the knight from e4 to a defensive square.

moves.popup:
Bxc6！换掉Nc6！
激活：消除c6马，准备换后
计划：Bxc6后dxc6，牺牲象换马，进入双兵对双兵残局
moves.popup_en: Bxc6! White exchanges the bishop for the c6-knight, preparing a queen trade and a simplified position with doubled c-pawns against White's pawns.

moves.popup:
dxc6黑方重新夺回
黑方双兵结构受损（c/c双兵）
moves.popup_en: ...dxc6 recaptures, leaving Black with doubled c-pawns.

moves.popup:
dxe5白方吃兵
中心打开，d列开放
moves.popup_en: dxe5 captures the pawn, opens the center, and clears the d-file.

moves.popup:
Nf5黑马反扑
黑马占领f5强格
moves.popup_en: ...Nf5 counterattacks and occupies an active square.

moves.popup:
Qxd8+！换后进残局！
这是柏林残局的标志性一步
双方进入无后残局——协调完全决定结果！
moves.popup_en: Qxd8+! The characteristic queen trade of the Berlin Endgame. With queens off the board, piece coordination becomes decisive.

moves.popup:
Kxd8黑王吃后
黑王被迫进入中心，丧失易位权
协调问题开始：黑王阻碍黑方双车连接！
moves.popup_en: ...Kxd8 recaptures. Black's king is drawn into the center and can no longer castle; its placement also makes connecting the rooks harder.

moves.popup:
Nc3白马出动
激活：第2马进入游戏
协调：Nf3+Nc3联合控d5/e4
注意：白方马在残局中非常协调！
moves.popup_en: Nc3 develops White's second knight. Together, Nf3 and Nc3 control d5 and e4, giving White's knights excellent coordination in the endgame.

moves.popup:
h6黑方防守h4
黑方被动防守
moves.popup_en: ...h6 prevents h4, but Black remains on the defensive.

moves.popup:
b3准备Bb2
激活：为激活象做准备
计划：Bb2象将到达最佳斜线
moves.popup_en: b3 prepares Bb2, where the bishop can reach its best diagonal.

moves.popup:
Ke8黑王移到e8
黑王准备连接双车
moves.popup_en: ...Ke8 moves the king and prepares to connect Black's rooks.

moves.popup:
Bb2！象到达大斜线！
激活：象在b2控制a1-h8大斜线
协调：Bb2（象控a1-h8）+ Nc3（控d5）联合
计划：双车+马+象协调控制局面
moves.popup_en: Bb2! The bishop reaches the long a1-h8 diagonal. Together with Nc3's control of d5, it coordinates with the rooks and knight to control the position.

moves.popup:
Be7黑方象出动
黑方象守备，但被动
moves.popup_en: ...Be7 develops the bishop, though Black's setup remains passive.

moves.popup:
Rad1！车进d列！
激活：最后一子入场
协调最终形态：
🐴 Nc3（控d5，压制黑方双兵）
🏹 Bb2（控大斜线）
♖ Rad1（控d列）
♖ Rfe1（控e列）
四子完美协调 vs 黑方被动防守！
✅ 相同材料，协调优势决定胜负
moves.popup_en: Rad1! The final piece joins the game. Nc3 pressures the doubled pawns and controls d5, Bb2 commands the long diagonal, Rad1 controls the d-file, and Rfe1 the e-file. Four coordinated pieces outplay Black's passive defense despite equal material.
